findings.summary: ImageMediaEngine report images render as static, non-focusable images and do not expose zoom, pan, or fit in Preview.
findings.reproduction: Fresh B report, created and edited through Report Hub and Inspector; open Preview at 390px. The newly uploaded 81-die detail crop is visibly present.

observed_facts.aria_label: Wafer map detail of the same 81 measured die; a localized group of lower-yield blue cells appears near coordinates X 2–3, Y 0–1.
observed_facts.caption: Detail crop of the 81 die measurements already shown in the wafer map above; it adds no observations.

findings.impact: The reader cannot inspect image evidence at increased scale or reposition it; this violates the governed image-evidence interaction contract for complete reports.

findings.area: Editable PowerPoint chart visible label layout
findings.summary: Dense editable chart output places category and legend labels too close to remain distinct in the available export preview; one RCA box-plot title also collides with its upper axis-label area.
findings.reproduction: Review E mixed-resource dispatch and B RCA Quick Look raster previews; the E chart shows adjacent half-hour categories and touching legend labels; B box-plot title approaches/overlaps the top y-axis tick region.

observed_facts.renderer: macOS Quick Look only; no LibreOffice/PowerPoint installed
observed_facts.package_semantics: The OOXML still preserves chart family, series names, ordered category caches, values, axis bounds and legends; Box Plot remains 23 editable quartile/median/whisker/category primitives and has no false lineChart part.
observed_facts.impact: Editable chart semantics survive, but visible chart category/series labels are harder to distinguish than the report decision requires in the exported document.

classification_basis: Concrete task/readability consequences observed in the mandated supported report and export workflows; no taste-only findings.
